mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The signed Final Terms dated 17 July 2026 identify ACM International Ltd as mAPOLLO's reference-portfolio manager and require the portfolio to remain delta-neutral. Permitted strategies include basis trading, market making, decentralized and centralized yield generation, and derivatives, with gross leverage capped at 8.0x. This supports the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype; the mandate does not establish observed hedge coverage or current reserve composition.

sources.label: Signed mAPOLLO Final Terms dated 17 July 2026: manager, delta-neutral mandate and investment rules
